query.text: 请帮我照看家里的老人，如果他起身走动时忘了拿拐杖，请及时提醒他。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the elderly person at home, and remind him in time if he gets up to walk around but forgets his cane.

annotation.text_zh: 您忘记拿拐杖了，请拿上拐杖，注意安全。
annotation.text_en: You forgot your cane. Please take it with you and stay safe.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
